name: – After recital A – Am 13
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: -A. whereas on 29 January 2026, the US administration under President Donald Trump escalated sanctions against Cuba by threatening retaliatory tariffs against countries supplying oil to the island; whereas on 1 May 2026, a new US executive order also introduced sanctions targeting foreign operators maintaining economic relations with Cuba, particularly in the energy, security and financial sectors; whereas on 4 June 2026, the United States announced new round of sanctions, including on President Miguel Díaz-Canel and some of his immediate family, alongside members of the Castro family; whereas the US administration also threatened foreign countries or entities with sanctions, leading to the immediate interruption of credit card payments in Cuba;
